function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content:
CPU usage refers to the amount of processing power your computer’s central processing unit (CPU) is currently consuming. It’s usually expressed as a percentage of the total available capacity. A high CPU usage (close to 100 %) indicates that many processes are demanding a lot of computational resources, while a low usage (e.g., below 10 %) means the CPU is largely idle.

If you’d like to see the real‑time CPU usage on your machine, let me know which operating system you’re running (Windows, macOS, Linux, etc.) and I can give you step‑by‑step instructions—or even run a quick command for you.
